section: Arizona corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax rate
note: Flat rate on Arizona taxable income of corporations for tax years beginning after December 31, 2016.
source_title: Arizona Revised Statutes 43-1111: Tax rates for corporations (Arizona Legislature)

section: Arizona corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Minimum corporate tax
note: Corporations pay the greater of $50 or the tax computed at 4.9%.
source_title: Arizona Revised Statutes 43-1111: Tax rates for corporations (Arizona Legislature)

label: Levied by
value: Counties, cities, towns, community college districts and school districts (plus special districts)
note: Each governing body fixes primary and secondary property tax levies and rates by the third Monday in August.
source_title: Arizona Revised Statutes 42-17151: County, municipal, community college and school tax levy

label: State oversight
value: Arizona Department of Revenue (general supervision of county assessors)
note: ADOR's own property tax page (azdor.gov) blocked automated access; statute cited instead.
source_title: Arizona Revised Statutes 42-13002: Relationship between department and county assessors

label: Residential property tax cap
note: Constitutional cap on ad valorem taxes collected from residential property: 1% of full cash value (as limited by Section 18).

label: Annual cap on taxable value increase
note: Since tax year 2015 the value used for all ad valorem taxes is the lesser of full cash value or 5% above the prior year's limited value.

label: Real estate transfer tax
value: None: the Arizona Constitution bars new real property sale or transfer taxes
note: Applies to the state, counties, cities and districts; fees or taxes already in existence on December 31, 2007 are not affected.
source_title: Arizona Constitution, Article 9, Section 24: Prohibition of new real property sale or transfer taxes
